intro.heading: About Travelling Places
paragraphs: At Travelling Places our aim is simple: to help you create your perfect tailor-made holiday, and to organise it flawlessly. It's something we've been doing successfully now for over 30 years. So, whether you're interested in history, wildlife, culture, adventure or relaxation, our destination specialists will help you arrange every element of your holiday, right down to the smallest detail, and all tailored to suit your own, individual requirements. That, after all, is the beauty of tailor-made travel. You decide where you want to go, how long for, what to see and who to see it with. The rest is taken care of by us.

story.heading: On the Mountain since 1993.
story.imageAlt: Gina Storey, founder of Travelling Places
paragraphs: Travelling Places was established by Gina Storey in 1993 on Tamborine Mountain. Gina's experience in the industry began in New Zealand and took her to London for 10 years where she worked as a product development manager for British Airways and marketing manager for Australian company Jetset in the UK and Europe. Relocating to Australia Gina put her extensive industry experience into creating a travel agency with a focus on service and creating wonderful experiences for travellers. Over the years Travelling Places has developed a client base all over Australia who have come to the agency for our focus on service.
It's a great source of pride that, to this day, Travelling Places remains a privately owned, family business. It's a fact that enables us to put you, our customer, at the heart of everything we do.

cruise.heading: We sail on the ships we recommend.
paragraphs: As a member of Cruise Lines International Association (CLIA) we undertake extensive training of cruise lines globally. We sail on and inspect ships regularly to ensure we can give you honest opinions and share our up to date knowledge. Whether you like an intimate sailing vessel, a luxury cruise ship, an expedition to the far reaches of the globe, or a river vessel we would be delighted to help. Gina is recognised as a Global Cruise Icon. There are under 300 in the world so her knowledge is extensive and she loves finding the right experience for you.
cruise.imageAlt: A small ship silhouetted at sea beneath the setting sun

virtuoso.heading: Part of Virtuoso.
paragraphs: Invited to join the global network Virtuoso, Travelling Places is recognised as a member of this exclusive club (the top 1% of agencies globally) and is able to share the benefits of this affiliation with their clients.
virtuoso.imageAlt: A quiet hotel room with a brass lamp and an open balcony door onto the sea at sunset
